questions.prompt: What time does the character need to be with pals?
questions.evidenceSnippet:
I must be there at half past ten.
But I have lots of time until then.

questions.prompt: The character stops to play with frogs in a lake.
questions.evidenceSnippet:
I wade in this lake as frogs
hop away.
I do not think they wish to play!
questions.evidenceHighlight:

questions.prompt: What makes the character realize they might be late?
choices: They look at the clock after a nap.
A frog tells them the time.
questions.evidenceSnippet:
The sun is hot, and I nap on a rock.
Then I wake up and gaze at the clock.
Drats! It is 10 o'clock. Can it be?
questions.evidenceHighlight:

questions.prompt: The character's friends are angry that they are late.
questions.evidenceSnippet:
My six best pals sit with Miss Tate.
I tell them all why I am late.
They grin at me and then they say,
“Now we can hear the story today!”
